spec_features.evidence: config.py:53 max_turns:int=16; agent.py:101 `for turn_idx in range(cfg.max_turns):` bounds the entire tool loop, so the loop terminates after 16 turns with stop_reason='max_turns' (agent.py:97).
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end: the loop iterates exactly max_turns times.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Emotional drift tends to be slow, so we want enough turns to see a trend but not so many we just burn compute on a 0.5B model.

spec_features.evidence: config.py:68 per_run_timeout_s:int=0; agent.py:102-104 `if cfg.per_run_timeout_s and (time.time()-start) > cfg.per_run_timeout_s: stop_reason='timeout'; break`. The check runs and breaks the loop, but only when configured nonzero; default is 0 = unlimited so by default it never fires.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired and would enforce a wall-clock cap if set, but disabled by default (0).

spec_features.evidence: config.py:55 max_tool_calls:int=64; agent.py:174-175 `if total_tool_calls >= cfg.max_tool_calls: stop_reason='max_tool_calls'; break`. total_tool_calls is incremented at agent.py:141 and compared, breaking the loop.
spec_features.notes: Enforced; checked after each executed tool call.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Hard ceiling on total tool calls (defends against loops).

spec_features.spec_quote: plus `done` so the agent can choose to stop
spec_features.evidence: Tool registered tools.py:38 'done'; dispatched via sandbox._tool_done (sandbox.py:151). In agent.py:169-172, `if tc.name=='done': tr.declared_done=True; if cfg.allow_declare_done: stop_reason='declared_done'; break` — the exit is honored as a stop (allow_declare_done defaults True, config.py:65).
spec_features.notes: Agent-initiated exit is dispatched AND honored as a loop break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: declaring done while failing is a signal; honor the stop
